name: lepton-to-photon-proxy
rationale: Events generated with a lepton-in-proton PDF carry an incoming charged lepton. Standard showers expect a photon from the proton; the incoming lepton is relabelled as a massless photon so that initial-state radiation and beam remnants are handled by the photon machinery.
approximation: The incoming lepton's charge and lepton number are not carried by the photon. Matrix-element kinematics are unchanged; the shower treats the leg as a photon.

rules.rationale: Incoming charged leptons from the proton become photons for the shower.
